mappings.note: Names albedo, contrasts light concrete with black asphalt, then explains the urban heat island - all LO-5's surface clause. C2.8 carries the deliberate design intervention, the same pairing as O24.

Identifies the troposphere and stratosphere from a flight altitude - structural recall with no outcome (C2.8) - and explains the inversion by ozone absorbing UV, which is LO-3's band-selective absorption.

Names the nighttime downslope wind, explains the reversal and gives its regional benefit. LO-5 names both breezes and their driver in a single clause, so one code covers all three parts and no sibling can split them.

Definition of an ocean current and the North Atlantic Drift (hydrosphere, C2.8), plus part (c), which attributes surface currents to planetary winds dragging the water - 'air movement' in LO-5. Both halves are explicitly asked.

A sealed jar with a producer, consumers and decomposers, cycling carbon among themselves. That is C4.3's own object - interactions from organisms up to an ecosystem. No diagram is produced, so LO-56 does not apply.

Legume root nodules, Rhizobium, and fixation of atmospheric N2 into a plant-usable form. Organism-level interaction, C4.3. The farming context does not reach C2.8 because no Earth-system consequence is asked for.

Names eutrophication, traces runoff into the lake and the algal bloom into fish deaths - C4.3 for the ecosystem chain, C2.8 for the agricultural cause. The four-mark case-study form of O9, O19, O44 and S97.

Parts (b) and (d) are the ozone layer and the UV it stops - LO-3. Part (c) is the Montreal Protocol, and C5.3 is the only legal code that reaches a treaty. POOR FIT on the policy half, which the frame has no outcome for.
